name: Windows Event Logs Cleared
description: The Security or System event log was cleared (event 1102 / 104) or wevtutil/Clear-EventLog/PowerShell was used to clear logs. A deliberate anti-forensics action.
query: event.code:("1102" or "104") or (event.provider:"Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code:"1" and process.name:("wevtutil.exe" or "powershell.exe" or "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line:(*"cl "* or *"clear-log"* or *Clear-EventLog* or *"Remove-EventLog"* or *"Limit-EventLog"*))
tags: Data Source: Windows Security Event Logs
false_positives: Rare legitimate admin maintenance — should be scheduled and communicated.
note:
### Triage
- Identify `user.name` and the host. Was there a change window?
- Pull surrounding events from other sources (Sysmon, forwarded logs, EDR) that were not cleared.
- Treat as an active-intrusion indicator until proven otherwise.
